serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m here.
???: Stop. If you go any further, the connection will break.
???: There's drainage a few metres from you. Left side of it is unscrewed. Put the backpack there. Then you can go back home.
You: That’s all? Will you leave me alone now?!
???: Sure, for now.
…
???: Good job. You are a real patriot. Wait for more orders. Soon.
???: We will contact you through the first phone. Destroy the second one. It has a removable battery.
Removable battery? It must be very old, no company produces cells like this now.
???: Pull out the battery and throw it out. Phone itself, break it in half. 
???: That’s all for today.
He hung up…
What was that all about? None of it made any sense, but it kinda freaked me out…
